name: Sa Sa International Holdings Limited
summary: Sa Sa International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the retail and wholesale of cosmetic products in Hong Kong, Macau, Mainland China, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company offers skincare, fragrance, make-up, hair care, body care, inner beauty, personal care, health food, and fitness products, as well as beauty equipment under various brands. It is also involved in the holding of intellectual property rights and properties; charitable activities; and the operation of online businesses.
